#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ALLOWED_TOOLS (Read only); never Bash, Edit or Write
allowed_tools="${ALLOWED_TOOLS:-Read,Grep,Glob,Agent}"
claude -p "$p" \
  --restricted \
  --permission-mode dontAsk \
  --allowedTools "$allowed_tools" \
  --disallowedTools "Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,WebFetch,WebSearch,ScheduleWakeup"

jobs:
  rules-pass:
    steps:
      - env:
          ALLOWED_TOOLS: Read
          AGENTS_FILE: ""
        run: bash ../../reviewer/scripts/run-claude.sh

export const SUBAGENT_TOOLS = ["Read", "Grep", "Glob"];
const PREAMBLE = "There is no shell: no Bash, no Edit, no Write.";
